entities.summary: Agneta Stark, was the vice chancellor of Dalarna University in Sweden from 2004-2010. Previously, Stark served as president of the International Association for Feminist Economics (IAFFE) (2012-2013) and as vice chair of the Association of Swedish Higher Education.
